decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several Bluetooth speakers with high ratings and strong review counts. I excluded several products that were actually accessories (shelves, cables, and cases) rather than speakers. Within my consideration set, the JBL Charge 4 (Renewed) was attractive but slightly more expensive as a refurbished unit. The EDUPLINK and comiso options offered great value for the price. Ultimately, I chose the JBL Go 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_129) because it comes from a highly reputable brand, has a stellar 4.7 rating, and offers the best combination of portability and proven performance for its $39.99 price point.
